# Brand voice

4 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/brand-voice` | Read a workspace's brand-voice profile |
| POST | `/api/v1/brand-voice` | Seed a workspace's default tone (onboarding) |
| PUT | `/api/v1/brand-voice` | Save a workspace's brand-voice profile |
| POST | `/api/v1/brand-voice/distill` | Distill learned style notes from editing history |

### GET /api/v1/brand-voice

Read a workspace's brand-voice profile

Any member may read. This is the grounding an AI generation uses — brand description, audience, product context, tone, style rules, exemplars and the distilled learned memo.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's profile, or null
  - `BrandVoiceReadResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `profile`: `BrandVoiceProfile` | null, required — Null when the workspace has never configured a profile — a legitimate answer, not an error.
      - `id`: string, required
      - `organizationId`: string, required
      - `brandDescription`: string, required
      - `audience`: string, required
      - `productContext`: string, required
      - `defaultTone`: one of `"professional"` | `"casual"` | `"bold"` | `"friendly"` | `"thought_leader"` | `"playful"` | `"hype"` | `"punchy"` | `null`, required
      - `styleRules`: object, required
        - `dos`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
        - `donts`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
        - `bannedPhrases`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
        - `emojiPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"sparing"` | `"freely"`
        - `hashtagPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"sparing"` | `"freely"`
        - `ctaPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"when_relevant"` | `"always"`
        - `language`: string (max length 100, default "")
      - `exemplars`: array of object, required
        - `id`: string, required
        - `text`: string (max length 2000), required
        - `note`: string (max length 200)
      - `learnedMemo`: string | null, required
      - `learnedMemoVersion`: integer, required — Bumped by the distillation job when it rewrites the memo, so a caller can tell whether a cached memo is stale. Never moved by a settings save.
      - `learnedMemoUpdatedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `aiLearningEnabled`: boolean, required
      - `useVoiceSamples`: boolean, required
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
      - `updatedAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/brand-voice

Seed a workspace's default tone (onboarding)

Creates a profile carrying only the chosen tone. Any member may seed — it is part of onboarding — but an existing profile is never overwritten.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `BrandVoiceSeedInput`
  - `organizationId`: string, required
  - `defaultTone`: one of `"professional"` | `"casual"` | `"bold"` | `"friendly"` | `"thought_leader"` | `"playful"` | `"hype"` | `"punchy"`, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The profile, and whether this call created it
  - `BrandVoiceSeedResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `seeded`: boolean, required — False when a profile already existed and was left untouched — so a caller isn't left assuming its tone was applied.
    - `profile`: `BrandVoiceProfile` | null, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `organizationId`: string, required
      - `brandDescription`: string, required
      - `audience`: string, required
      - `productContext`: string, required
      - `defaultTone`: one of `"professional"` | `"casual"` | `"bold"` | `"friendly"` | `"thought_leader"` | `"playful"` | `"hype"` | `"punchy"` | `null`, required
      - `styleRules`: object, required
        - `dos`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
        - `donts`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
        - `bannedPhrases`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
        - `emojiPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"sparing"` | `"freely"`
        - `hashtagPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"sparing"` | `"freely"`
        - `ctaPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"when_relevant"` | `"always"`
        - `language`: string (max length 100, default "")
      - `exemplars`: array of object, required
        - `id`: string, required
        - `text`: string (max length 2000), required
        - `note`: string (max length 200)
      - `learnedMemo`: string | null, required
      - `learnedMemoVersion`: integer, required — Bumped by the distillation job when it rewrites the memo, so a caller can tell whether a cached memo is stale. Never moved by a settings save.
      - `learnedMemoUpdatedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `aiLearningEnabled`: boolean, required
      - `useVoiceSamples`: boolean, required
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
      - `updatedAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
- `400` — Invalid request

### PUT /api/v1/brand-voice

Save a workspace's brand-voice profile

Requires `brandVoice:update` (owner/admin/manager). A full save of the content fields; `learnedMemo` and the AI toggles fall back to their stored values when omitted, so a partial client never wipes what the distillation job learned or silently turns learning off.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- any
  - `brandDescription`: string (max length 2000, default "")
  - `audience`: string (max length 2000, default "")
  - `productContext`: string (max length 2000, default "")
  - `defaultTone`: one of `"professional"` | `"casual"` | `"bold"` | `"friendly"` | `"thought_leader"` | `"playful"` | `"hype"` | `"punchy"` | `null`
  - `styleRules`: object (default {})
    - `dos`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
    - `donts`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
    - `bannedPhrases`: array of string (max 20 items, default [])
    - `emojiPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"sparing"` | `"freely"`
    - `hashtagPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"sparing"` | `"freely"`
    - `ctaPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"when_relevant"` | `"always"`
    - `language`: string (max length 100, default "")
  - `exemplars`: array of object (max 8 items, default [])
    - `id`: string, required
    - `text`: string (max length 2000), required
    - `note`: string (max length 200)
  - `learnedMemo`: string | null (max length 8000)
  - `aiLearningEnabled`: boolean
  - `useVoiceSamples`: boolean
  - `organizationId`: string, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The saved profile
  - `BrandVoiceUpdateResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required

      - `id`: string, required
      - `organizationId`: string, required

        - `emojiPolicy`: one of `"never"` | `"sparing"` | `"freely"`

### POST /api/v1/brand-voice/distill

Distill learned style notes from editing history

Requires `brandVoice:update`. Rewrites the learned memo from the workspace's generation history and bumps `learnedMemoVersion`.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- object
  - `organizationId`: string, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The refreshed memo
  - `BrandVoiceDistillResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `memo`: string, required
    - `version`: integer, required
    - `counts`: object, required
      - `editedPairs`: integer, required
      - `shippedUnchanged`: integer, required
      - `refineEvents`: integer, required
      - `rejectionComments`: integer, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `422` — Learning disabled for the workspace, or not enough signal
  - `Error`
- `500` — Distillation failed
  - `Error`
